I mean, I did okay in school, so I don’t want to make it sound worse than it was, but even in elementary school teachers would tell my parents I was bright, just kind of… off in my own world a lot.\n\nI’d lose worksheets, forget about homework, or not turn it in unless my mom went through my backpack every night and made sure it was there.
